titleEn: Minimum Garden Perimeter to Collect Enough Apples
title: 收集足够苹果的最小花园周长
summary: 无限方格中坐标绝对值和决定苹果数，求以原点为中心的最小正方形周长，使内部苹果至少 neededApples。
insight: 半边长 n 的正方形内苹果总数为 2n(n+1)(2n+1)，随 n 单调增加。指数扩展上界后二分最小 n，周长为 8n。
pitfalls: 二分比较乘积不会超 long 范围

solutions.title: 闭式苹果和二分
solutions.idea: 利用累计苹果公式寻找最小半边长。
steps: right 从 1 倍增到 total>=needed
二分最小可行 n，返回 8*n

code.java: class Solution { private long apples(long side){return 2*side*(side+1)*(2*side+1);}public long minimumPerimeter(long neededApples){long left=1,right=1;while(apples(right)<neededApples)right*=2;while(left<right){long middle=(left+right)/2;if(apples(middle)>=neededApples)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return 8*left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun apples(side:Long)=2*side*(side+1)*(2*side+1);fun minimumPerimeter(neededApples:Long):Long{var left=1L;var right=1L;while(apples(right)<neededApples)right*=2;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(apples(middle)>=neededApples)right=middle else left=middle+1};return 8*left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long apples(long long side){return 2*side*(side+1)*(2*side+1);}public: long long minimumPerimeter(long long neededApples){long long left=1,right=1;while(apples(right)<neededApples)right*=2;while(left<right){long long middle=(left+right)/2;if(apples(middle)>=neededApples)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return 8*left;} };
